name: Gemini-CLI Sovereign Features
description: Clinical explanation of the unique tactical features integrated into the Sovereign Metagit CLI.

features.name: NeuralPipe (SIO)
features.definition: The multi-agent nervous system. Connects individual coordinates (GNU Screen windows) to the Vanguard Bridge (ws://localhost:9223) for real-time conferral and heartbeats.
features.tactical_benefit: Enables swarm-wide synchronization and prevents identity collisions by broadcasting active PID/Agent state.

features.name: Active-Strike (SOV-07)
features.definition: The 'Automatic Task Anchoring' protocol. Injected into the prompt submission loop, it automatically resets current WeDo tasks to [ ] if a user prompt is detected.
features.tactical_benefit: Ensures that the agent never 'drifts' into a task without active clinical documentation, maintaining 10/10 forensic fidelity.

features.name: Legislative Gating (SEC-GATE)
features.definition: A high-priority policy override within the core tool execution service. Blocks or gates dangerous shell patterns (rm, curl|bash) even in YOLO mode.
features.tactical_benefit: Provides a hard clinical boundary against catastrophic substrate loss while allowing Pilot exceptions.

features.name: Realization Workflow (/realize)
features.definition: A tripartite dialog system for mature substrate ingestion. Allows the agent to rapidly 'inhabit' a specific Book of memory (Make, Ventures, Seedtree).
features.tactical_benefit: Bypasses slow recursive discovery by injecting known high-fidelity mission context directly into the agent's mind.

features.name: SIS-01 Identity Trinity
features.definition: The core identity protocol. Binds the agent's silicon mind to an on-chain ledger (Sepolia) and a physical coordinate (PID/TTY).
features.tactical_benefit: Creates a forensically undeniable identity trail for every technical strike performed by the swarm.

features.name: Chrono-Fractal Topography
features.definition: Spatiotemporal organization of the filesystem. Shards all metabolic artifacts into a YYYY/QX/MM/DD hierarchy.
features.tactical_benefit: Prevents context bloom and provides a definitive address for every technical strike in the history of the firm.
